compiled_state.title: Create PR-80 diff fixture file for schema-compliance verification
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1 (partial): Provides the input for the verification run — the PR-80 diff fixture that runner.py is invoked against.

## What
Generate a git diff of PR #80 (worktree-20260508-140855) and write it to `tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/pr-80.diff`.

PR-80 diff range: `git diff 18a18cd07189abd8abce003578cdf65d903aa4f3..89fbb04b01`

This produces the unified diff for the 12-file attribution hook change (~3200 lines) that was the source of the 8/11 invalid findings in bug d42d-8126.

## Implementation Steps
1. Run `git diff 18a18cd07189abd8abce003578cdf65d903aa4f3..89fbb04b01 > tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/pr-80.diff` from the repo root.
2. Verify the file exists and is non-empty.
3. Confirm the diff covers the expected files (post-functions.sh, apply-attribution-trailers.sh, and related test files).

## Unit Test Exemption
test-exempt: (1) the fixture file has no conditional logic — it is pure data; (2) any test would be an existence-only check (change-detector); (3) the task is infrastructure-boundary-only — a test fixture with no business logic.

## File Impact
| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| `tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/pr-80.diff` | Create |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || echo "no python changes — lint N/A"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || echo "no python changes — format N/A"
- [ ] Fixture file exists at expected path
  Verify: test -f $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/pr-80.diff
- [ ] Fixture file is non-empty (≥ 100 lines)
  Verify: LINES=$(wc -l < $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/pr-80.diff); [ "$LINES" -ge 100 ]
- [ ] Fixture covers expected files from PR-80 (post-functions.sh and apply-attribution-trailers.sh present in the diff)
  Verify: grep -q "post-functions.sh" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/pr-80.diff && grep -q "apply-attribution-trailers.sh" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/pr-80.diff

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
